module.purpose: Provides server-side login-page routing and props preparation for authenticated users, first-time setup, JWT-based TOTP login, and configured authentication providers.
module.summary: This server-side page handler authenticates the incoming request, validates an optional encrypted TOTP JWT, safely redirects existing sessions, routes an empty database to initial administrator setup, and otherwise supplies CSRF and provider configuration to the login page. It combines session access, JWT verification, redirect sanitization, database inspection, environment configuration, and SSO feature flags.
module.businessContext: Supports the product's authentication entry point and first-user onboarding. Failures can misroute users, expose unsafe redirects, block login, or prevent initial administration setup.
functions: getServerSideProps (~L13-94): Routes login requests and returns redirects or authentication page properties.
verifyJwt (~L18-23): Verifies TOTP JWT claims using the configured encryption secret.

io: Reads the current server session through the request context.
Counts users through the Prisma database client.
Requests a CSRF token for the page props.
env: Reads process.env.CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY to construct the JWT verification secret.

contractsProvided.name: login-page-props
contractsProvided.shape: { csrfToken, isGoogleLoginEnabled, isSAMLLoginEnabled, samlTenantID, samlProductID, totpEmail }

contractsConsumed.name: jwtVerify
contractsConsumed.shape: jwtVerify(jwt, secret, { issuer: WEBSITE_URL, audience: `${WEBSITE_URL}/auth/login`, algorithms: ["HS256"] })

sectionMap.name: session acquisition
sectionMap.intent: Loads the server session associated with the incoming request.

sectionMap.name: TOTP token validation
sectionMap.intent: Validates an optional JWT and extracts its email claim.

sectionMap.name: authenticated-session routing
sectionMap.intent: Redirects an already authenticated user away from the login page.

sectionMap.name: callback redirect handling
sectionMap.intent: Sanitizes and applies a requested callback destination when available.

sectionMap.name: first-user onboarding routing
sectionMap.intent: Sends an empty installation to administrator setup.

sectionMap.name: login page props
sectionMap.intent: Builds login-page data with CSRF and provider configuration.

edgeCases.behavior: Skips JWT validation and continues with normal session and onboarding routing.
Redirects to the authentication error page with an invalid JWT message.
Redirects to the authentication error page with an invalid payload message.

edgeCases.inputShape: Authenticated request with unsafe or rejected callback URL
edgeCases.behavior: Logs the redirect validation error when thrown, then redirects to the root path.

boundaryConditions.intent: Detects an empty database requiring initial administrator onboarding.

errorHandling.action: Logs the exception and continues to the default authenticated redirect.

invariants.description: A valid TOTP JWT must provide a payload before its email claim is used.
Session-based redirects occur before database counting and login props generation.
Authenticated users without an accepted callback destination are redirected to the root path.
The unauthenticated login response includes CSRF and authentication-provider properties.

assumptions.description: The framework supplies a valid server-side props context containing request and query data.
CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY is available and suitable for HS256 JWT verification.
The Prisma user model is available to count existing users.

ambiguities.question: Is the JWT email claim guaranteed to be a string when present?
ambiguities.affects: totpEmail type and downstream TOTP login behavior

ambiguities.question: Does getSafeRedirectUrl reject all external or unsafe callback destinations?

concurrencyModel.notes: Each request uses local state and awaits session, JWT, database, and CSRF operations in sequence.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An authenticated user supplies a safe callback URL.
given: getServerSession({ req }) resolves to a session
moduleContractTests.rationale: Authenticated users must be returned to a validated requested destination.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An authenticated user does not provide a usable callback URL.
given: getServerSession({ req }) resolves to a session
moduleContractTests.rationale: Authenticated users must not see the login page.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A TOTP query token fails JWT verification.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Invalid authentication tokens must produce the dedicated retry error.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A TOTP JWT verifies but has no payload.
given: verifyJwt(context.query.totp as string) resolves to an object with no payload
moduleContractTests.rationale: Successful cryptographic verification is insufficient without a JWT payload.

moduleContractTests.scenario: No session exists and the database contains no users.
moduleContractTests.rationale: The first user must be created through onboarding before normal login is available.

moduleContractTests.scenario: No session exists and at least one user already exists.
moduleContractTests.then: result.props equals { csrfToken: "csrf-token", isGoogleLoginEnabled: IS_GOOGLE_LOGIN_ENABLED, isSAMLLoginEnabled, samlTenantID, samlProductID, totpEmail: null }
moduleContractTests.rationale: The login page must receive CSRF, provider configuration, and TOTP state.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An unauthenticated request includes a valid TOTP JWT containing an email.
given: verifyJwt(context.query.totp as string) resolves to { payload: { email: "user@example.com" } }
moduleContractTests.rationale: A valid TOTP token carries the email needed by the login flow.
